test_title: PYST 22: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure from the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ee6bd9a0518341828727ae1f60de8437596a15285bd3a6e92f3d19db4f75e90.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Step I: The arrow moves 90⁰ in the anticlockwise direction and is shifted 1 place previously.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2b93326a6c9ec37cebadf629a353881e58dea751df8458e883ab0fe05b50750d.png] 

Step II: The triangle moves vertically and shifted from one place to the next.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90787809ca8d9e94a56b1121454d4846b3627edc302d0fb023a9c8823e009d2c.png] 

So, the final series will be:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff34342b881d7985c1d40eb0e8f7eb80f97d2bd73c225bd00f800306b5f271e9.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
